sourceReview.scope: Bounded author review of exact two staged files; no independent execution or review inferred

implemented: Functional private protocol/result/lifecycle adapter delivering four ChildScopedDataPort purposes when a separately supplied constructor-owned native transport fulfils its exact private contract
boundaries: Native data lease/generation/nonce grants only a partition, never parent/PIN/profile/package/current-rights admission
JS isCurrent controls local publication and does not authenticate native commit
Transport must map actual private native Lease/Cancellation/CAS/retirement under native lock; no default factory or public plugin exists
Abort/timeout settles caller promptly; pending native job holds capacity until its actual completion
Host must erase its views before lifecycle/account/profile/route changes; no frame or App wiring claim
CAS false may follow committed bytes and lost acknowledgement; no post-commit rollback claim
